purpose: Canonical UI plan for consolidating the active CEP architecture/merge train, runtime/UI proof backlog, Generation Graph dependency chain, and Windows release-security remediation into one evidence-driven sequence.
authority_rule: Live Adobe_AI_Generations-04 source, PR state, current branch/HEAD, AE/CEP runtime evidence, release workflows, built artifacts, signatures and hashes outrank this projection.

plan_truth.next_single_question: Can PR #330 pass focused/static validation and live AE/CEP single-lane execution proof before the dependent capability/UI work advances?

nodes.title: Current CEP baseline
nodes.summary: main HEAD d6c8c800; package version 2.3.52. development remains feature-integration truth and main the release/governance lane. Static/deploy success does not equal live AE runtime proof.

nodes.title: CI routing repair
nodes.summary: PR #306 is closed without merge; main later received CI/nightly trigger repairs. Before any merge train is called green, prove development-targeted workflows actually create jobs and do not reopen a release path from branch aliases. Patch surface: .github/workflows/enforcement-gates.yml and workflow trigger mapping/tests.

nodes.title: PR #330 — one execution lane
nodes.summary: Open draft, mergeable. Consolidate Chat Play, Library Run/Apply/Play All and Script Editor Run through ExecutionPayloadRunner → canonical codeblock consumer → governed Library/host lane. Patch files currently span 4 files on branch fix/execution-surface-single-lane-cleanup. Required fix: remove late direct CEPExec bypass/classifier/action mapping, restore 1500-line shared limit, fail Script Editor closed, align booted handler, make Play All sequential. Acceptance: one dispatch, lock release, repeat run, no overlap/duplicate execution in live AE.

nodes.title: Salvage superseded execution proof
nodes.summary: After #330, compare old proof PRs #315/#319/#325/#326. Port only missing compatible regression assertions; reject obsolete bypass architecture. Preserve editor-shell ownership tests from #326 if still unique.

nodes.title: PR #328 — capability registry + ToolRouter
nodes.summary: Open draft, mergeable. Patch branch feature/cep-capability-boundary currently changes 10 files. Fix split-brain tool authority by deriving model-visible capability snapshot from the registry, fail closed for unregistered/blocked capabilities, route public AEReadTools through ToolRouter, and leave mutation in the approval/action dispatcher. AE proof must show live read tools, CAPABILITY_UNREGISTERED, no recursion/duplicate calls, and unchanged mutation gating.

nodes.title: PR #331 — Settings cleanup
nodes.summary: Open draft, mergeable; 2 changed files on fix/settings-surface-cleanup. Fix duplicate About ownership, false no-provider state, normal-user model/preset exposure, internal File Path Memory diagnostics, and developer-only leakage. Preserve provider adapters, SecurityManager/API-key storage and boot order. CEP proof: one render, provider/key/local config work, simplified file locations, diagnostics only in Developer Mode.

nodes.title: PR #327 — icon reference integrity
nodes.summary: Open draft, mergeable, but still based on main and must be retargeted/rebased to development. Patch validator + focused tests so missing/empty/non-canonical/case-drift icon references fail deterministically while dynamic/external references are not falsely blocked. Focused local tests reported 5/5; current-branch validation still required.

nodes.title: Retire integration/final-feature-alignment safely
nodes.summary: Do not merge the retired integration branch wholesale. Classify each unique item present/ported/rejected after #330/#328/#331. Candidate salvage includes Gemini registration, ChatResponse contract, token estimates, provider latency, inline hardening, Gallery/import flow, typography, image intent, CI aliases, orphan/test adjustments.

nodes.title: PR #329 — Generation Graph foundation
nodes.summary: Open draft, mergeable; 6 changed files on feature/generation-graph-foundation. Keep graph Run disabled and no raw AE execution/provider spending. Rebase only after #328. Patch/acceptance: second CEP panel opens, approved AE read invoker feeds selected layer/comp/property/effects catalog, typed sockets reject invalid links, persisted graph contains no raw AE pointers/secrets/executable JSX.

nodes.title: Consolidated live CEP proof sweep
nodes.summary: Revalidate known runtime-sensitive areas through the thin dev loader + localhost:8088: provider settings/API-key secrecy, script-editor rewrite/buttons, toast/debug noise, Ctrl+A scope, Local AI duplicate injection, readiness warnings, screenshot/gallery path, execution lock/duplicate dispatch, icons and user-visible developer cards. Close only with live AE/CEP evidence.

nodes.title: Windows Authenticode architecture
nodes.summary: v2.3.52 release path disables Electron signing discovery and tolerates signing failure. Fix scripts/installers/build-win-installer.mjs so the inner Electron executable is signed and signing failure aborts. Configure a trusted Windows code-signing identity/provider rather than relying on Apple credentials.

nodes.title: Sign + verify final Inno EXE
nodes.summary: After Inno compilation, Authenticode-sign Letterblack-GenAI-Windows-vX.Y.Z.exe with timestamping. Patch .github/workflows/release.yml to verify both the inner Electron EXE and final installer with Windows-native signature checks; absent/untrusted/wrong-publisher signatures must fail the release.

nodes.title: Remove hidden PowerShell elevation
nodes.summary: Current installer main.js uses hidden powershell.exe + Start-Process -Verb RunAs. Replace with a conventional elevation mechanism where possible; otherwise document necessity and prove it is bounded. Re-audit tasklist/process enumeration, staging/removal and executable-launch behavior for AV heuristic reduction.

nodes.title: Artifact provenance + hashes
nodes.summary: Generate and publish SHA-256 for Windows EXE, DMG, ZXP and canonical ZIP; bind all to tag + source commit. Compare the exact Gumroad ZIP hash against the GitHub release bundle before distribution. Preserve existing macOS Developer ID/notarization/stapling and ZXP signature gates.

nodes.title: Clean-machine + AV release acceptance
nodes.summary: Clean Windows install/upgrade/uninstall smoke must prove signature trust, user-scope behavior, AE/CEP + ScriptUI placement and cleanup. Then review Defender/SmartScreen/VirusTotal against the exact signed hash. Do not require arbitrary zero detections; investigate behavioral detections.

nodes.title: Publish hardened replacement release
nodes.summary: Release sequence: development consolidation → AE runtime proof → PR main → pre-tag gate → tag → release.yml → signature/hash/provenance checks → clean-machine/AV review → GitHub Release → Gumroad replacement. No distribution before all P0 gates pass.
